headline: ibyyue adds to its ARC-2 gold run

sections.text: ibyyue gained 21.67 points to reach 65.56, moving from 25th to 10th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The new board snapshot puts ibyyue among the 15 gold places after its earlier move into the medal group.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
